rows.grounds: long compound; other-than parama-advaita unity attainment

items.question: How does supreme lord unity attainment relate to all else?
premises: Supreme unity attainment excludes all else
All is indeed other than it
items.inference: Thus supreme unity is exclusive and all else is other.
items.plain_english: All is indeed other than attainment of unity with the supreme dense bliss-consciousness lord.
